attr.title: Tony Hawk's Underground
attr.desc: Neversoft's 2003 skateboarding game, running natively: Story Mode, Free Skate, Create-a-Skater, Create-a-Park and the intro videos.
attr.inst: Requires the USA Xbox version. Extract your disc image with extract-xiso and copy what it produces (default.xbe and the data folder) into ports/thug/gamedata. Made for 640x480 devices with 1 GB of RAM.
